column1: # Hockey Influences: the curated registry. One row per influence. Edit here, then run: npm run data:influences

column8: blurb (must not name the player)
Sees the play two passes before anyone else on the ice.
Big, smooth and impossible to take the puck from.
Finds the quiet ice, finishes, then backchecks.
Flat-out speed down the wing and a quick release.
Three explosive strides and gone on a breakaway.
Captain first: scores, checks and blocks shots.
Drags a team into the fight and wins it.
Gets open, one-times it, raises his arms.
Protects the puck on his hip until you give up.
The quiet captain with the fastest wrist shot going.
Runs you over, then sets up the goal.
Skates like the wind at both ends of the rink.
Pure goal scorer: the puck is in before you see it.
Hair flying, full speed, slap shot off the rush.
Does everything, forever, and you feel every shift.
The hardest shot anyone had seen, taken at full speed.
From the blue line in, nobody wanted it more.
Parks in the slot and cannot be moved.
Wins the draw, wins the corner, wins the game.
Jersey flapping, fastest stride on the ice.
A freight train with soft hands.
Hits like a truck and scores like a sniper.
Goals, hits and the odd scrap, all in one night.
Picks your pocket and makes you look silly doing it.
Wins every battle below the goal line.
One-timer from the left circle. Everyone knows. It goes in anyway.
Slows the game down with the puck on a string.
Top speed with the puck, and then another gear.
Scores, hits, fights and shakes your hand after.
Small, clean, clever and very fast.
A big captain with a long reach and a heavy shot.
Undersized, relentless, best when it matters.
The heavyweight. Nobody takes liberties with his linemates.
Short, square and always first off the bench.
The smallest guy out there, playing like the biggest.
Grace, reach and class in every shift.
A crafty centre who made everyone around him better.
Always in the right spot, always wins the draw.
Explodes through the neutral zone, angry.
Big, unpredictable, takes over a game by himself.
A defenceman who leads the rush end to end.
Never out of position, never rattled, never in the box.
Keep your head up crossing his blue line.
Plays half the game and hits the net every time.
A fourth forward with the smoothest stride in hockey.
Mean, tireless, and still playing at an age nobody believes.
The slap shot goalies have nightmares about.
Hits you, takes the puck, starts the rush.
A calm giant who clears the front of the net.
Walks the blue line and threads the pass.
Long reach, nasty streak, first pass on the tape.
Effortless skater who is never in a hurry.
The biggest man on the ice with the hardest shot.
Edges and deception from the back end.
Drops to the butterfly and dares you to beat him.
No style at all. Stops everything anyway.
A third defenceman who plays every single night.
Tall, calm, leaning on his stick between whistles.
Gives up five, then makes the save that wins it.
Crouched low, fearless, face first.
Intense, technical and a little bit scary.
Deep in the net, square to everything.
So calm it looks easy.
Shoots the puck, swings the stick, owns the crease.
